description: Periodic AGGREGATE public-accountability transparency report assembled by danjo_oversight_report. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605301600 §3/§4. Aggregate-first (G10): publishes patterns over a reporting period; named-party content permitted ONLY where source records already name the party publicly AND severity-gated + Council-reviewed under 1 SBT = 1 vote (G10/G11). Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain; IPFS-pinned (replication ≥2). NON-adjudicating: the report summarizes factual cross-references and any external-counsel referrals; it renders no verdict (G4).

summary.description: Aggregate-first factual summary of the period's cross-reference patterns. No legal conclusions (G4).

observationCids.description: danjo.discrepancyObservation CIDs included in this report

aggregateStats.description: JSON-encoded aggregate counts by category/severity (no per-individual scoring; anti-individualism N9)

namedPartySection.description: Named-party observation CIDs published under G10 (source already names party + severity-gated + Council-reviewed + 1 SBT = 1 vote). Empty unless all gates pass.

oneSbtOneVoteChainCid.description: If namedPartySection is non-empty: the 1 SBT = 1 vote publication-approval chain hash (G11; ADR-2605192315 pattern)

stateAlignedFlagsPresent.description: True if any source carried stateAlignedFlag (G13)

publishedCid.description: IPFS CID of the published report (replication ≥2)
